facts.fact: Gabonactu reports that the 2026 primary-school certificate (CEP) results were published on 27 June 2026 through the KEWA platform, run by the national digital agency ANINF, with ANINF engineers credited for it.
Gabonactu reports that ANINF, a state agency, ran the KEWA platform that published the Education ministry's CEP 2026 results online on 27 June 2026.
